name: Single espresso
description: A 30 ml shot of our house blend, pulled at 93°C for a thick crema and a chocolate finish.

name: Double espresso
description: Two shots of the house blend, the same 25-second pull, twice the depth.

name: Ristretto
description: A short 20 ml pull that keeps the sweetness and leaves the bitterness behind.

name: Macchiato
description: A double shot marked with a spoonful of steamed milk foam.

name: Flat white
description: Double ristretto under a thin layer of velvety microfoam. Served in a 180 ml cup.

name: Cappuccino
description: Equal parts espresso, steamed milk and foam, dusted with cocoa on request.

name: Oat latte
description: Double shot with steamed oat milk, naturally sweet and dairy-free.

name: Mocha fix
description: Espresso and 70% dark chocolate ganache, topped with steamed milk.

name: Cortado
description: A double shot cut with an equal measure of warm milk. Small and strong.

name: Butter croissant
description: Laminated over three days with cultured butter, baked fresh every morning.

name: Almond croissant
description: Yesterday's croissant reborn with frangipane, flaked almonds and icing sugar.

name: Cardamom bun
description: Soft, knotted dough spiced with cardamom and finished with pearl sugar.

name: Banana bread
description: A thick slice with walnuts and a brown-butter glaze. Made with very ripe bananas.

name: Bacon and egg roll
description: Smoked streaky bacon and a fried egg on a milk bun with house tomato relish.

name: Turkey and brie
description: Roast turkey, brie, cranberry and rocket on toasted sourdough.

name: Roast vegetable focaccia
description: Grilled courgette, red pepper and aubergine with basil pesto and mozzarella.

name: Cold brew
description: Our signature. Slow-steeped for 16 hours, 65% less acidity, twice the caffeine. Served over ice.

name: Oat cold brew
description: The 16-hour cold brew softened with oat milk. Naturally sweet and dairy-free.

name: Cold brew tonic
description: Cold brew poured over tonic water with a twist of orange peel. Bright and bitter.

name: Iced matcha latte
description: Ceremonial-grade matcha whisked with your choice of milk over ice.
